nights.title: Ragheb Alama
nights.name: Ragheb Alama
nights.extract: Ragheb Sobhi Alama is a Lebanese music artist and television personality. Alama began his career in the 1980s when he appeared as a contestant on the talent show broadcast Studio El Fan, on which he received the Platinum Award.

nights.title: Ziynet Sali
nights.name: Ziynet Sali
nights.extract: Ziynet Sali Safter is a Cypriot singer who also holds British citizenship. Her later works contain pop elements while her earlier works also had rebetiko and classical Turkish music themes.

nights.title: Paradise Lost
nights.name: Paradise Lost
nights.extract: Paradise Lost are a British gothic metal band. Formed in Halifax, West Yorkshire, in 1988, they are considered pioneers of death-doom and the main influence on gothic metal. As of 2005, Paradise Lost have sold over two million albums worldwide.
